cohort: 76,862 women with hyperglycemia in pregnancy who delivered in France in 2015
finding: Postpartum T2DM screening uptake was low (42.9%) among women with hyperglycemia in pregnancy in France, and several demographic, socioeconomic, and pregnancy-related factors were associated with screening uptake.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a slightly lower likelihood of attending postpartum T2DM screening compared to vaginal delivery.
